subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Does OpenClaw still need an explicit per-spawn strict-silent parent mode now that current main already sends completions to the requester session and lets the parent decide whether to reply externally?
rationale: Implementation mechanics are credible, but only maintainers can decide whether the small semantic difference—forcing `deliver:false` instead of relying on the existing parent decision path—deserves a permanent tool and persisted-state contract.

options.title: Use Current Parent-First Path
options.body: Close this PR and the linked feature request because current main already gives the requester the completion and control over user-visible delivery.

options.title: Sponsor Strict Silent Mode
options.body: Keep the PR only after documenting a concrete unsupported workflow and defining failure, restart, and user-visibility semantics for the per-spawn option.

recommendation.title: Use Current Parent-First Path
recommendation.body: Close this PR and the linked feature request because current main already gives the requester the completion and control over user-visible delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work spans the requester-session handoff, sessions_spawn contract, and subagent lifecycle policy needed for this decision.
